name: Acceptance suite-3 test 60 - non-unique Sids flagged; statement identity stays distinct
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign A. Two statements share the Sid 'RepeatedSid'. Colliding Sids are legal JSON (distinct array members), so analysis proceeds, but the DUPLICATE_SID coverage flag is raised and the two statements keep DISTINCT indexes/identity - graph IDs, finding IDs and export records must not overwrite one another. The second statement's iam:PassRole on Resource:* still produces its wildcard finding.
rationale: Sid is display evidence, not a stable identity key (architecture note: 'Sid is display evidence, not stable identity'). Duplicate Sids are valid JSON and valid IAM, so the tool must not block, but it must warn (DUPLICATE_SID) and key every internal record on the statement INDEX so two RepeatedSid statements never collapse into one row/node/export entry. Ref: IAM JSON policy grammar (Sid uniqueness is only enforced within a single statement's scope, not across statements).
